key: Robocop 2 (1991)(Ocean)[cr Melnok](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$CE800 to $070000 (2048 bytes):0:0526
name: decode_variable_length_bitstream
description: Reads bits from a stream of 32-bit words, least significant bit first, and decodes variable-length codes through a subroutine. The decoded values are written to a destination buffer, so it works as a bit-stream decoder for a packed block.

key: Robocop 2 (1991)(Ocean)[cr Melnok](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$CE800 to $070000 (2048 bytes):0:0608
name: read_n_bits_from_stream
description: Reads a count of bits from a stream of 32-bit words, accumulating them into a word one bit at a time, and refills from the preceding word when the current one is used up.

key: Robocop 2 (1991)(Ocean)[cr Melnok](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$D4800 to $071000 (20992 bytes):0:0106
name: fetch_shifted_bit_word
description: Returns the longword just before the address pointer, shifted right one bit with its top bit set. It supplies one word at a time to a bit reader.

key: Robocop 2 (1991)(Ocean)[cr Melnok](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$D4800 to $071000 (20992 bytes):0:0120
name: advance_bit_reader_count
description: Shifts a bit register right once per count step, refilling it from the preceding longword with its top bit set whenever it empties, and stops when the count is used up.

name: start_music_voice_streams
description: When the input is one, sets up four voice records from a table, each with a stream pointer, and reads the first command bytes of each stream. A non-negative byte selects a table entry, while the sentinel bytes set loop, volume or parameter values; any other input defers to a subroutine.

name: update_four_voice_flags
description: On each tick, updates four voice-state words: when a pending bit is set it advances a counter, merges each voice's flags with the saved values, calls subroutines for voices that have data, and clears the pending bits.

name: reset_four_voice_state
description: Clears two global values and calls a subroutine four times, once per voice, then clears a pending-state word.

name: init_voice_record
description: Clears the first word of a voice record, sets its active flag and clears its next field, then clears a word at a second pointer.

name: start_voice_streams_from_table
description: Sets up voice streams from a table in the same way as its neighbouring routine, reading the first command bytes of each stream that has an entry.

name: init_voice_streams_with_value
description: For each of four voice table entries whose offset is nonzero, clears the voice record fields, stores the input value into the record, and reads its command stream with the same command decoding as its neighbours.

name: decode_voice_command_stream
description: Decodes the command bytes of a voice stream: code one stores the stream pointer, codes two and three store parameter bytes, a non-negative byte selects a table entry, and the sentinel ends the stream. Once every voice is processed it merges the input flags into a global word.

name: decode_voice_stream_commands
description: Decodes voice stream bytes: code one stores a parameter byte, code two stores another, a non-negative byte selects a table entry, and the sentinel ends the stream. When every voice is finished it merges the input flags into a global word.

name: decode_voice_stream_loop_codes
description: Decodes voice stream bytes, storing a loop pointer on the loop code and a parameter byte on the following code. A non-negative byte selects a table entry and the sentinel ends the stream; once all voices are processed the input flags are merged into a global word.

name: init_voice_records_from_streams
description: For each voice whose table offset is nonzero, clears its record fields, stores the input value, and decodes its stream with the same codes as its neighbours. Its final step merges the input flags into a global word.

name: forward_unrecovered_call_short
description: A 19-instruction routine that calls one unnamed routine and is reached from three unnamed routines. Its pseudo-code could not be produced, so only these call links are known.

name: forward_unrecovered_call_tiny
description: An eight-instruction routine that calls one unnamed routine and is reached from outside normal control flow. Its pseudo-code timed out, so only that call is known.

name: run_unrecovered_large_body
description: A 181-instruction routine called by one unnamed routine that calls one other. Its pseudo-code timed out, so its purpose cannot be stated from the evidence.

name: update_four_audio_channels
description: Writes the DMA control register and, for each channel whose flag bit is set, sets its period and volume registers and loads its sample pointer and length. It waits on the interrupt request register and the raster position before updating.

name: run_slave_startup_sequence
description: Stores the loader interface pointer, calls several loader service functions through its table, and sets a fixed control value. It then checks the returned identifier against two accepted values: on mismatch it stores an error code and returns, otherwise it jumps into the loaded code.

name: run_slave_service_calls
description: Calls two loader service functions through the interface table, then a called routine, and then a final function from the table.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it does nothing when called.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it does nothing when called.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it does nothing when called.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it does nothing when called.

name: enable_dma_and_store_limit
description: Writes a fixed DMA control value and, when the input is nonzero and below a small limit, stores that input into two fields of a structure.

name: forward_loader_service_call
description: Calls one loader service function through the interface table and returns without other changes.

name: enable_master_bitplane_copper_dma
description: Writes a fixed DMA control value that enables the master, bitplane and copper DMA bits.

name: xor_highscore_file_buffer
description: Calls a loader service function that returns a status. When the status is nonzero it calls another service function and XORs a 160-byte buffer with a descending key; the text it references is the high-score file. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it does nothing when called.

name: forward_loader_service_call
description: Calls one loader service function through the interface table and returns without other changes.

name: call_loader_service_if_set
description: When the input value is nonzero, calls one loader service function through the interface table; otherwise it returns straight away.

name: clear_colour_registers_long_loop
description: Repeatedly writes a zero value into four consecutive colour registers, about fourteen thousand times, then clears a global. The writes go to colour entries after the first colour register.

name: halt_if_flag_else_set
description: If a global flag and a CIA port bit are both set it enters an endless loop. Otherwise it sets the global flag to a fixed value.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it does nothing when called.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it does nothing when called.

name: configure_custom_chip_registers
description: Writes the DMA control register and two other custom-chip control registers. The pseudo-code timed out, so the exact sequence is not recovered beyond that, and the routine calls seven unnamed routines.

name: invoke_system_trap_zero
description: Issues trap number zero and returns the input registers unchanged.

name: call_routine_then_vector_four
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then calls the routine stored at a fixed offset of a pointer register, and returns.

name: load_amigados_hunk_file
description: Checks for the AmigaDOS executable header marker and, when it is present, walks the hunk list and places each hunk in memory with a relocation step.

name: place_hunk_sections_in_memory
description: Lays out hunk sections from a header table, computing each section's address and size, and calls a relocation step for each one. It is a variant of its neighbouring hunk loader.

name: layout_hunks_and_clear_bss
description: Lays out the hunk sections from a header table, calling a relocation step for each one, and then clears the zero-initialised sections that follow the data.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value one and does nothing else.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value one and does nothing else.

name: zero_three_longword_blocks
description: Clears three blocks of longwords, each sized by a count and addressed by a pointer kept in the stack frame, then returns a value from the frame.

name: return_stacked_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without any change.

name: copy_span_into_plane_columns
description: Converts an x position into a word column and bit offset by dividing by twelve, rejects spans that run past a fixed limit, and copies the span in chunks, carrying the remainder into the next row.

name: retry_clear_table_three_passes
description: Makes up to three passes, calling routines on each. When a status bit is set it clears a twelve-entry table of words and checks the outcome; it finishes by setting a status word and returning a result code.

name: setup_disk_controller_registers
description: Writes fixed values to the disk-related custom registers: the DMA and disk length controls, the sync word, the buffer pointer and a control word.

name: verify_sector_headers_and_checksum
description: Scans track data for sector header sync words, decodes each header's odd and even bits, and checks the sector number and checksum against expected values. It returns error codes for a bad sync, a bad checksum or a mismatched sector.

name: run_until_counter_set
description: Calls two routines and repeats until a 16-bit counter field becomes nonzero, running at least two passes before it returns.

name: checksum_256_longwords
description: XORs together 256 longwords from a buffer, then returns the masked combined value.

name: decode_mfm_longwords_with_xor
description: Decodes 128 longwords by combining the odd and even bit masks of consecutive source pairs, XOR-ing each result with the previous one, and stores them in the destination.

name: halve_indexed_table_word
description: Looks up a word in a table by an index, calls a routine when its top bit is set, and halves it. It then stores the input word and a returned value.

name: clear_indexed_word_when_ready
description: Polls a status bit over up to eighty-six passes, calling a routine on each pass. Once the bit is clear it zeroes the table word for the current index and returns the routine's result.

name: compute_cia_port_mask
description: Builds a port control byte with one bit cleared, chosen by an index plus three, and clears a further bit when a lookup table entry for that index is set.

name: pulse_port_bits_count_times
description: Repeats for a count: each pass obtains a value from a routine, clears one port bit when a sign test passes, forces bit zero high, and writes the port byte.

name: set_adkcon_bit_if_flagged
description: Writes a fixed control value, then when a flag word is negative writes a bit-set pattern for a bit chosen by an index plus three into the same register.

name: set_port_bit_for_index
description: Combines an input byte with a bit selected by an index plus three, setting that bit in the port value and writing the result.

name: wait_for_flag_result_one
description: Sets a control byte to all ones and calls a routine, then repeatedly calls another routine and spins while a status bit is set, until that routine returns one. It then returns zero.

name: wait_for_flag_and_result
description: Repeatedly calls a routine until it returns one, spinning on a status bit between calls, and then returns zero.

name: start_timer_when_idle
description: When a status bit is clear and the input is not one, writes three fixed control values to the timer control register.

name: set_ciab_timer
description: Writes three fixed control values in sequence to the timer registers, covering the timer control register and the timer high and low bytes.

name: load_hunk_sections_from_header
description: Checks for the executable header marker and, when present, walks the hunk table, places each section in memory and calls a relocation step for each one.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value one and does nothing else.

name: copy_longwords_then_zero_rest
description: Copies a counted block of longwords from the source into the destination at a stored address, then zeroes the remaining space up to a stored size, and returns one.

name: copy_longwords_then_zero_rest
description: Copies a counted block of longwords from the source into the destination at a stored address, then zeroes the remaining space up to a stored size, and returns one.

name: zero_counted_longword_block
description: Clears a counted block of longwords starting at a stored destination pointer, then returns one.

name: apply_relocation_list
description: Walks a list of records, each holding a count and offsets, and adds a stored value to the longword at each offset within the destination block, until a zero count ends the list. It returns one.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero and does nothing else.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it does nothing when called.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value one and does nothing else.

name: return_constant_zero
description: The listing shows only a return of zero, so the routine returns zero without other work, and seven unnamed routines call it.

name: forward_single_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns without other changes.

name: init_display_then_idle_forever
description: Writes DMA control values and two table words, clears a 32-word block of globals, then waits for a global to reach a fixed value. It ends in an endless loop and never returns.

name: wait_for_global_then_set
description: Calls one routine, then repeatedly calls three routines until a global value becomes nonzero, and finally stores a fixed value into that global.

name: start_copper_list_and_idle
description: Writes DMA and copper control values, sets two table words, clears a 32-word block of globals, and waits for a global to reach a fixed value. It then stops in an endless loop.

name: fill_records_with_stepped_values
description: Writes a stepped value into a table of eight-byte records, storing its low and high words in each record and adding a fixed step per record for the given count.

name: setup_display_and_wait_forever
description: Writes two pairs of values to the display setup words, clears a 32-word block of globals, and busy-waits on a global to reach a fixed value before entering an endless loop. It calls a raster-line wait during setup.

name: wait_for_global_then_halt
description: Busy-waits until a global value equals minus one, then enters an endless loop.

name: wait_copper_global_then_set
description: Calls one routine, then repeatedly calls three routines until a global value becomes nonzero, and stores a fixed value into it. The copper pointer register is touched in the same region.

name: copy_sixteen_longword_table
description: Copies sixteen longwords from one fixed table to another fixed table location.

name: wait_until_global_nonzero
description: Busy-waits while a global value is zero, then returns.

name: split_colour_into_components
description: Sets a state value and clears a 48-word table. For each input colour word it splits the red, green and blue fields into scaled values, storing three words per colour, then stores the count and end pointers.

name: step_palette_fade_up
description: Advances a colour fade one step by adding a per-channel step to the red, green and blue values of each entry. It writes back each changed colour, counts the changes, and returns when none remain.

name: store_colour_components_two_tables
description: Sets a state value and clears a 48-word table, then splits each input colour into scaled red, green and blue values in one table and into shifted nibble values in a second table.

name: step_palette_fade_down
description: Advances a colour fade by subtracting a per-channel step from each nonzero red, green and blue component of each entry, counting changes, and stops when no component changes.

name: run_packed_block_decoder
description: Sets up a decoder record with buffer pointers and limits, reads the packed size from the input, then loops over decoding calls that copy output until the packed size is used up.

name: set_record_from_input_pair
description: Copies a value from an input pair into a record field, adjusting it by one when the second field is zero. It then sets a fixed scale field and advances the input pair by one unit.

name: init_record_fields_and_call
description: Stores two fixed values into record fields and calls one unnamed routine.

name: build_ramp_lookup_table
description: Fills a table of words with a rising ramp of paired values, followed by a falling sequence that starts at minus two.

name: decode_packed_symbols_with_tables
description: Builds decoding tables in a stack frame from the input parameters, then reads bytes and maps each value through the tables into output words. It calls one unnamed routine during decoding.

name: decode_compressed_copy_stream
description: Reads a compressed input stream and writes output bytes, using the bits and counts it reads to copy earlier output or emit literal values. It calls three unnamed routines during decoding.

name: decode_bit_stream_symbols
description: Reads bits from an input stream in sized groups, maps each group through a table, and writes the decoded symbols to an output buffer. It calls two unnamed routines.

name: rotate_xor_decode_block
description: Transforms 32 bytes: each input byte is rotated left by two bits, XOR-ed with the previous output byte, and written to the output buffer, so each result depends on the one before it.

name: run_decoder_state_machine
description: Sets up a decoder state record and, when the input count is nonzero, drives a state machine that refills bit buffers and emits output, calling four unnamed routines. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: check_result_or_report_error
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns normally when its result is nonnegative. Otherwise it stores an input value in a record and returns an error code of three.

name: call_stored_pointer_return_result
description: Calls the routine held in a record pointer, then returns the value stored in a second record field.

name: convert_packed_pixels_to_planes
description: Converts pixel data from packed four-bit values into bitplane layout by swapping bit groups with masks, writing the results into output longwords.

name: init_display_then_idle_forever
description: Sets a global pointer, calls a routine, writes two sets of table words, clears a 32-word block of globals, and waits for a global to reach a fixed value before entering an endless loop.

name: wait_copper_global_then_set
description: Calls one routine, repeatedly calls three routines until a global becomes nonzero, then stores a pointer into a global. The copper pointer register is touched in the same region.

name: fill_records_with_stepped_values
description: Writes a stepped value into a table of eight-byte records, storing its low and high words in each record and adding a fixed step per record for the given count.

name: wait_for_global_then_halt
description: Busy-waits until a global value equals minus one, then enters an endless loop.

name: stub_self_copy_longwords
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a global block onto the same addresses, so it has no effect on memory.

name: wait_until_word_nonzero
description: Busy-waits while a word value is zero, then returns.

name: split_colour_into_components
description: Sets a state value and clears a 48-word table. For each input colour word it splits the red, green and blue fields into scaled values, storing three words per colour, then stores the count and end pointers.

name: step_palette_fade_up
description: Advances a colour fade one step by adding a per-channel step to the red, green and blue values of each entry. It writes back each changed colour, counts the changes, and returns when none remain.

name: store_colour_components_two_tables
description: Sets a state value and clears a 48-word table, then splits each input colour into scaled red, green and blue values in one table and into shifted nibble values in a second table.

name: step_palette_fade_down
description: Advances a colour fade by subtracting a per-channel step from each nonzero red, green and blue component of each entry, counting changes, and stops when no component changes.

name: access_unrecovered_shared_block
description: A twelve-instruction routine whose address is taken by absolute move instructions and which four unnamed routines reach. Its pseudo-code timed out, so its purpose is not recovered.

name: stub_bad_data_after_call
description: Stores fixed values into globals and calls one unnamed routine. The code after that call is bad data, so the routine is effectively a stub that does not return normally.

name: stub_bad_data_after_call
description: Stores fixed values into globals and calls one unnamed routine. The code after that call is bad data, so the routine is effectively a stub that does not return normally.

name: run_main_frame_loop
description: Runs an endless outer loop that calls a sequence of unnamed routines on each pass and adds a fixed amount to a global counter twice per step. It exits an inner loop on specific codes and calls one unnamed routine when one of them is reached.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it does nothing when called.

name: read_controller_button_bits
description: Selects one of two controller ports, toggles the port output line, and reads eight bits serially from the button status register into a byte. It returns zero when the result is all ones.

name: wait_for_serial_handshake_pair
description: Calls one unnamed routine, waits for one status bit and then another to become set, and calls the same routine again.

name: install_interrupt_vector_handler
description: Saves the current interrupt control value, disables all interrupts, stores the previous vector in a record, replaces it with a handler, and then sets the interrupt enable value.

name: handle_interrupt_request_bits
description: Handles pending interrupt request bits: when a flag bit is set it calls a routine from a table and a sequence of unnamed routines, then marks the state complete.

name: reset_input_and_counters
description: Calls several unnamed routines, clears two counters, and writes a fixed value to the paddle output register.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it does nothing when called.

name: delay_loop_countdown
description: Counts down a large fixed number of steps, writing a fixed value to a global on each pass, to pause execution before returning.

name: forward_two_calls
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns.
